stories.title: Off SEC report, LSU's Leavitt 'available' to start, source says
stories.summary: A unique 48 hours of tracking the health of LSU's Sam Leavitt ended Friday, when he was not listed on the SEC availability report for Saturday's game at Ole Miss, and a source later told ESPN's Heather Dinich that the quarterback is "available" to start.

stories.title: Oregon wins in 84-0 rout despite missing 2 key players on offense
stories.summary: The Ducks were without some key players on offense Friday night in their historic 84-0 rout of Portland State as top wide receiver Jeremiah McClellan and starting tight end Jamari Johnson sat out because of injuries.

stories.title: Pistons' Ausar Thompson lands 5-year, $155M extension, sources say
stories.summary: Pistons All-Defensive forward Ausar Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $155 million rookie-scale contract extension, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Fever's Mitchell surprised by postgame party after setting season scoring record
stories.summary: Kelsey Mitchell scored 33 points to set a WNBA season scoring record Friday night in a win at Toronto. When confetti rained down as she entered the Fever locker room, Mitchell's first thought was that coach Stephanie White had passed another milestone.

stories.title: Rams' Donald plans to play; Nacua sits practice
stories.summary: Rams DT Aaron Donald said Friday "the plan" is to play Monday night against the Giants, while WR Puka Nacua did not practice on Friday with a hip issue.
